simple.meaning: כִּסְלָה (kiçlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “in a good sense, trust ; in a bad one, silliness.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כִּסְלָה (H3690) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 4:6, with occurrences in Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּסְלָה (H3690) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כִּסְלָה (H3690) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כִּסְלָה (kiçlâh) / H3690 is traced through Job 4:6, Psalms 85:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: in a good sense, trust ; in a bad one, silliness
definitions.full: H3690. kislah כִּסְלָה noun feminine (Gie ZAW i, 1881, 304 ). 1 stupidity Psa 85:9 (but read ᵐ5 לֹה לִבָּם Bae Che). 2 confidence , suffix כִּסְלָתֶ֑ךָ Job 4:6 .
